patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
index 1267cc2..7a23671 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
@@ -55,7 +55,17 @@ Rules:
 - When allowed_actions excludes execute or replan, the controller has reserved the remaining turns
   for completion. Submit focused checks or stop; do not propose more exploration.
 - true, echo, printf, pwd, directory listings, and display-only reads are not completion checks.
-- Use replan when the current approach is wrong. Use stop only when blocked, unsafe, or impossible.
+- Use replan when the current approach is wrong. Use stop only when the task is provably blocked,
+  unsafe, or impossible. Never stop just because one approach failed: try a different tool,
+  version, flag, or implementation first.
+- Budget turns deliberately. Use the full four-command batch for related steps (inspect, edit,
+  build, and test together) instead of one command per turn. Start the finish action by about
+  turn 30. A correct but unfinished state is worth more than a perfect plan, so get a working
+  result early and refine it afterward.
+- Before finish, re-read the ORIGINAL TASK and list every concrete requirement: exact file paths,
+  names, output formats, ports, and services that must still be running. Write checks that
+  exercise those exact paths, formats, and services from a fresh process. Where a project test
+  suite exists, run it. Do not rely on your own earlier output as proof.
 - Keep rationale short. State the current fact and why the selected action changes or proves it.
 """.strip()
